newsitem.title: EGYPT: Syrian president coming to Egypt Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Syrian president coming to Egypt Thursday.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad will travel to the south Sinai resort of Sharm el-Sheikh on Thursday for talks on the Middle East with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, official sources said.
Assad, who regularly consults with Mubarak, is expected in Sharm el-Sheikh at about 11 a.m. (0800 GMT), they said.
Earlier this week Mubarak visited Kuwait and Saudi Arabia for similar discussions.

The Egyptian president has said he is willing to call a regional summit if Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu shows a willingness to back down on a controversial Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
The participants at that summit would be Mubarak, Netanyahu, King Hussein of Jordan and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, Mubarak said last week.
